name: mmd2vsdx
description: Mermaid → Visio VSDX converter (pure Node/TypeScript, no Visio dependency)

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module -e "import {cpSync,mkdirSync} from 'node:fs'; import {join} from 'node:path'; const root=process.cwd(); const s=join(root,'source','parser','ext'); const d=join(root,'dist','parser','ext'); mkdirSync(join(root,'dist','parser'),{recursive:true}); cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true}); console.log('[copy-assets] '+s+' -> '+d);"
